objective: Strengthen existing calculator automation so new calculators reach official-reference quality without copying FGTS-specific content or changing existing public calculators.
inScope: Turn the FGTS reference's quality traits into a versioned canonical reference-conformance contract.
Define required modules and calculator-specific conditional modules.
Define prohibited anti-patterns with measurable detection rules.
Strengthen Calculator Blueprint with typed hero, journey, field-step, result, memory, actions, content and mobile contracts.
Strengthen Calculator Gold Standard with visual hierarchy, spacing, CTA, focus, mobile and density requirements.
Require a pre-generation physical reference study and module adaptation map.
Add a result contract covering scenario, inputs, premises, source, dominant value, secondary indicators, formulas, intermediate values, rounding, interpretation and limitations.
Add a step-by-step calculation-memory contract and structured verification table contract.
Add post-result action requirements: copy, print and downloadable report when applicable.
Add configurable product-recommendation slot with hidden/neutral fallback.
Strengthen workflow, playbook and checklist gates for structural depth and reference parity.
Require rendered desktop/mobile browser evidence, overflow checks and visual approval.
Make missing browser evidence blocking for production-quality certification.
Add validation fixtures proving that a generic form page fails and an adapted reference-quality calculator passes.
outOfScope: Copying FGTS-specific fields or legal content
Creating a new engine or data root
acceptanceCriteria: Reference physical study is recorded before generation.
Every required module has measurable content and behavior criteria.
Conditional modules include a documented applicability decision.
Result can stand alone as a useful calculation report.
Desktop and mobile rendered evidence is mandatory.
A shallow existence-only calculator is rejected.
Existing calculators remain unchanged until separately approved.
